agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted conditional in boltons/urlutils.py URL.get_authority(): changed `if not (self.password):` to `if self.password:` so the `:password` userinfo segment is only appended when a password actually exists. This resolves the roundtrip/userinfo/quoted-userinfo regression where URLs with passwords lost them and URLs without passwords got a stray colon and quoted None. Verified via manual round-trip checks and the module's doctest suite (11 passed).
